landmarks.name: Sydney Opera House
landmarks.hint: A sail-shaped performing arts complex on a harbourside peninsula, a UNESCO World Heritage Site

landmarks.name: Sydney Harbour Bridge
landmarks.hint: The world's largest steel arch bridge, nicknamed 'the Coathanger' by locals

landmarks.name: The Rocks
landmarks.hint: Sydney's oldest neighbourhood, a sandstone precinct at the base of the harbour bridge

landmarks.name: Darling Harbour
landmarks.hint: A waterfront leisure precinct on the western edge of the CBD, home to an aquarium and IMAX cinema

landmarks.name: Sydney Town Hall
landmarks.hint: A Victorian-era civic building with a grand clock tower, at the heart of the city grid

landmarks.name: Central Station
landmarks.hint: Sydney's main railway terminus, marked by a grand sandstone clock tower built in 1906

landmarks.name: Sydney Cricket Ground
landmarks.hint: A historic oval sports ground that has hosted Test cricket since 1882

landmarks.name: Bondi Beach
landmarks.hint: Australia's most famous beach, a crescent of white sand just 8 km from the city centre

landmarks.name: Centennial Park
landmarks.hint: A grand Victorian parkland opened in 1888 to mark the centenary of European settlement

landmarks.name: Newtown
landmarks.hint: An eclectic inner suburb known for King Street, vintage shops, and a thriving live music scene
